description: This file defines the AWS Support client class SupportClient, extending AwsClient, with method annotations for support-related operations.

classes.name: SupportClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Support services, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToSet
methods.description: Adds attachments to a set in AWS Support.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds attachments to a set in AWS Support.

methods.name: addCommunicationToCase
methods.description: Adds communication to an AWS Support case.

methods.name: addCommunicationToCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds communication to an AWS Support case.

methods.name: createCase
methods.description: Creates a new support case.

methods.name: createCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new support case.

methods.name: describeAttachment
methods.description: Describes an attachment.

methods.name: describeAttachmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes an attachment.

methods.name: describeCases
methods.description: Describes support cases.

methods.name: describeCasesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes support cases.

methods.name: describeCommunications
methods.description: Describes communications for a case.

methods.name: describeCommunicationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes communications for a case.

methods.name: describeCreateCaseOptions
methods.description: Describes options for creating support cases.

methods.name: describeCreateCaseOptionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes options for creating support cases.

methods.name: describeServices
methods.description: Describes AWS support services.

methods.name: describeServicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes support services.

methods.name: describeSeverityLevels
methods.description: Describes severity levels for support cases.

methods.name: describeSeverityLevelsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes severity levels.

methods.name: describeSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Describes supported languages for support.

methods.name: describeSupportedLanguagesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes supported languages.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckResultAsync
